preparation_source:
from pathlib import Path
import shutil

base = Path('.build/k91/mutants')
files = ['scripts/vm-guest-exec.py', 'scripts/vm-guest-exec-lib.sh', 'scripts/vm_capture_artifact.py', 'scripts/vm-capture-evidence-lib.sh', 'Tests/scripts/vm-capture-evidence.bats', 'Tests/scripts/fixtures/capture-cli.py', 'docs/verification/settings-activation/persisted-01/failure-observed.png']
for name, old, new in [
    ('filters', 'pixels[row * row_size] > 4', 'pixels[row * row_size] != 0'),
    ('multi', 'if ended_data:', 'if ended_data or seen_data:'),
    ('ancillary', 'elif kind[0] < 97:', 'elif True:'),
]:
    root = base / name
    for file in files:
        target = root / file
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(file, target)
    path = root / 'scripts/vm_capture_artifact.py'
    source = path.read_text()
    assert source.count(old) == 1
    path.write_text(source.replace(old, new))
